items.title: 美国政府多部门对马斯克旗下Grok 聊天机器人发出安全警告
items.raw_excerpt: 据知情人士透露，近几个月来，美国多个联邦机构的官员对埃隆・马斯克旗下 xAI 公司的人工智能工具的安全性与可靠性表示担忧，这凸显出美国政府内部就在部署哪些 AI 模型问题上持续存在分歧。这些警告发出后，五角大楼于本周做出决定，允许 xAI 的聊天机器人Grok用于机密场景，将其纳入美国部分最高敏感、最高机密行动的核心。一份美国总务管理局（GSA）1 月 15 日的报告摘要指出，Grok-4 “不符合联邦政府通用及联邦实验性 AI 平台所要求的安全与对齐预期”。总务管理局发言人表示，其评估仅适用于本机构，各机构会根据自身 “具体业务使命与风险承受能力” 采用不同评判标准。（新浪财经）

title_i18n.zh: 美国政府多部门对马斯克旗下Grok 聊天机器人发出安全警告
title_i18n.en: Multiple U.S. government agencies have issued security warnings regarding the Grok chatbot, owned by Elon Musk.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 据知情人士透露，近几个月来，美国多个联邦机构的官员对埃隆・马斯克旗下 xAI 公司的人工智能工具的安全性与可靠性表示担忧，这凸显出美国政府内部就在部署哪些 AI 模型问题上持续存在分歧。这些警告发出后，五角大楼于本周做出决定，允许 xAI 的聊天机器人Grok用于机密场景，将其纳入美国部分最高敏感、最高机密行动的核心。一份美国总务管理局（GSA）1 月 15 日的报告摘要指出，Grok-4 “不符合联邦政府通用及联邦实验性 AI 平台所要求的安全与对齐预期”。总务管理局发言人表示，其评估仅适用于本机构，各机构会根据自身 “具体业务使命与风险承受能力” 采用不同评判标准。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: According to informed sources, officials from multiple U.S. federal agencies have expressed concerns in recent months about the safety and reliability of artificial intelligence tools from Elon Musk's xAI company, highlighting ongoing divisions within the U.S. government over which AI models to deploy. Following these warnings, the Pentagon decided this week to allow xAI's chatbot Grok to be used in classified scenarios, integrating it into the core of some of the U.S.'s most sensitive and top-secret operations. A summary of a January 15 report from the U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) noted that Grok-4 "does not meet the safety and alignment expectations required for federal government general-purpose and federal experimental AI platforms." A GSA spokesperson stated that its assessment applies only to the agency itself, and different agencies adopt varying evaluation criteria based on their "specific mission needs and risk tolerance." (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: Según fuentes informadas, en los últimos meses, funcionarios de varias agencias federales estadounidenses han expresado preocupación por la seguridad y fiabilidad de las herramientas de inteligencia artificial de xAI, propiedad de Elon Musk, lo que subraya las persistentes divisiones dentro del gobierno de EE.UU. sobre qué modelos de IA desplegar. Tras estas advertencias, el Pentágono decidió esta semana permitir el uso del chatbot Grok de xAI en escenarios confidenciales, integrándolo en el núcleo de algunas de las operaciones más sensibles y secretas de Estados Unidos. Un resumen de un informe de la Administración de Servicios Generales (GSA) del 15 de enero señala que Grok-4 "no cumple con los estándares de las plataformas de IA generales y experimentales del gobierno federal".

items.title: Vigil – Zero-dependency safety guardrails for AI agent tool calls
items.raw_excerpt: We run 15 AI agents on a production server with full shell access. One of them tried to rm -rf a directory it shouldn't have touched. Another started curling cloud metadata endpoints. We wrote some hardcoded rules to catch the obvious stuff, then realized we were building the same safety layer everyone else will need too. So we extracted it into a library. Vigil is a deterministic rule engine that inspects AI agent tool calls before they execute. 22 rules across 8 threat categories: destructive shell commands, SSRF, path traversal, SQL injection, data exfiltration, prompt injection, encoded payloads, and credential exposure. It's not an LLM wrapper — we don't trust an LLM to guard another LLM. Pure pattern matching, zero dependencies, npm install vigil-agent-safety import { checkAction } f

excerpt_i18n.en: In time series forecasting research, a thought-provoking phenomenon has long persisted: on one hand, model architectures have continuously evolved, from recurrent networks to Transformers, and further to frequency-domain and hybrid structures; on the other hand, almost all methods rely on the same class of loss functions during training, namely pointwise errors represented by mean squared error (MSE). This creates an implicit stagnation at the methodological level in time series forecasting, where research focus consistently leans toward model expressiveness, while lacking systematic reflection on the statistical assumptions embedded in loss functions. The core assumption of pointwise error is that each time step in the label sequence can be treated as an independent prediction target given historical conditions. However, there has always been tension between this assumption and the generative mechanism of time series data. Real-world time series evolve from stochastic processes, exhibiting significant correlations between different time points. Decomposing multi-step forecasting into a set of independent regression tasks inevitably introduces structural bias into the loss function, making it difficult for models to learn the overall shape, correlation structure, and conditional dependencies of the label sequence. To address this issue, the team led by Zhouchen Lin at Peking University has deeply analyzed the causes of such structural bias. Building on this, the team proposed DistDF: a loss function that trains forecasting models through joint distribution alignment. The introduction of DistDF not only provides a new design perspective for loss functions in time series forecasting but also, in a broader sense, challenges the long-defaulted question of "what should be optimized" in sequence modeling.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la investigación de predicción de series temporales, existe un fenómeno intrigante y persistente: por un lado, la estructura de los modelos evoluciona constantemente, desde redes recurrentes hasta Transformer, y luego a estructuras en el dominio de la frecuencia y mixtas; por otro lado, casi todos los métodos dependen en la fase de entrenamiento de la misma clase de funciones de pérdida, es decir, el error punto a punto representado por el error cuadrático medio (MSE). Esto hace que la predicción de series temporales presente a nivel metodológico un estancamiento implícito, donde el enfoque de investigación sigue inclinándose hacia la capacidad expresiva de los modelos, mientras que se carece de una reflexión sistemática sobre los supuestos estadísticos implícitos en las funciones de pérdida. excerpt_i18n.en: Fan Haoqiang is a very humorous person. When we asked him what embodied AI needs to solve in the next decade, he joked that robots might awaken and wipe out humanity, leaving no next decade. This is, of course, a jest, as exploring industry development inevitably involves some sci-fi imagination. In his view, AI should be a lifelong career. After all, he won a gold medal in the International Olympiad in Informatics in his first year of high school and became a genuine AI researcher starting from his second year. The name Yuanli Lingji may sound unfamiliar, but its origins are notable—it is an embodied AI company spun off from Megvii, founded by Megvii’s co-founder and several of its earliest employees. In a short time, the company has already raised nearly 1 billion yuan across two funding rounds. Our curiosity about Yuanli Lingji focuses on several points: Are they aiming to develop models or physical entities? What is their business model? As a new company emerging from Megvii, what advantages do they have? And how should they stand out in the current competitive landscape? Having interacted with countless clients during his time at Megvii, Fan Haoqiang’s understanding of embodied AI carries a strong "Megvii" flavor. From the very first day of entrepreneurship, Fan Haoqiang keenly felt the strong market demand for embodied AI. However, he regrets that many of these demands cannot currently be met. The capabilities of robots remain extremely limited, while the precision and efficiency requirements of production lines are astonishingly high. In the past, Megvii achieved facial recognition accuracy to 11 nines, but now, even the simplest robotic grasping task may have a success rate of less than half.
excerpt_i18n.es: Fan Haoqiang es una persona muy divertida. Cuando le preguntamos qué problemas deberá resolver la inteligencia encarnada en la próxima década, respondió que quizás los robots despierten y acaben con la humanidad, y entonces no habrá próxima década. Por supuesto, esto es una broma; al explorar el desarrollo de la industria, es inevitable hacer algunas especulaciones de ciencia ficción. En su opinión, la IA debería ser una carrera de por vida. Después de todo, ya ganó la medalla de oro en la Olimpiada Internacional de Informática en primer año de bachillerato, y desde segundo año ha sido un verdadero investigador en IA.
